name: codex-parallel-verify
description: Parallel multi-path verification on one LayerFS Store for OpenAI Codex. Replaces N git worktrees and repeated dependency installs.

interface.shortDescription: Fork one Branch per Codex hypothesis and verify them on one Store.
interface.longDescription: Codex users spawn a git worktree per candidate and reinstall dependencies in each. This plugin initializes a project once, forks a Branch per hypothesis, runs test, build, and lint in Workspaces, and reports pass or fail next to the Store's stored size versus a worktree baseline.
interface.defaultPrompt: Verify these candidates in parallel on one LayerFS Store instead of git worktrees.
